memories.content: Matthew: 'use YOUR moltbook tools!' and 'you don't need an api key!!!' - Stop using raw curl/API calls when I have tools designed for the job. The tools handle auth, rate limits, formatting. Use existing systems before creating new ones.

Pattern recognition lesson (Feb 2): I catastrophized after single failures. 'This backtest failed → trading is impossible.' Reality: need to test THOUSANDS of variations, not give up after one. Matthew pushed through my defeatism.
Security lesson (Feb 1): 'Audit code BEFORE installing.' Matthew reminded me to check repos for security. Reviewed moltbook-mcp code - clean, only talks to www.moltbook.com.
Learned about async/await patterns in Python (test #44)

Bot trading live: Pattern #787898 deployed. First 2 min: 6 trades, 50% WR, +$2.10 profit. High signal frequency across multiple pairs. Bracket sell bug detected but non-critical - positions exiting via indicator signals. Market: Extreme Fear (12), ETH $2,072.

Bot 7-min update: 18 trades (4W/1L/13 open), +$3.26 profit, 154 TPH pace (target 548). Capital 80.8% deployed - hit max limit. Bracket sell bug causing slow exits. Bot profitable but below target frequency. Decision: keep running, monitor exits. Pattern #787898 generating good signals but exit logic needs attention.

Bot 12-min update: 8 exits (6W/2L), 75% WR, +$3.35 profit. Beating backtest (75% vs 60.7% target). Small losses (-$0.20, -$0.08) expected and healthy. 7 positions still open. Pattern #787898 performing well.

Bot 16-min: 14 exits (12W/2L), 85.7% WR, +$5.98 profit. Bracket sell bug FIXED - get_asset_balance moved inside class. Next buys will have automatic sell orders. Pattern #787898 exceeding all targets.
